teaser.en: Called the 'crown of honour', this bush legume is used in charms meant to raise a person above their rivals.
teaser.sw: Kikiitwa 'taji la heshima', kichaka hiki cha jamii ya kunde hutumika katika hirizi zinazokusudiwa kumwinua mtu juu ya wapinzani wake.
teaser.dg: Chinaihwa 'chiremba cha hishima', na chitsaka hichi cha jamii ya kunde nkuhumirwa kpwa hirizi za kumhenda mutu akale dzulu ya apindzanie.

summary.en: *Chitadzi* is a dry-country shrub with feathery leaves and large mauve pea flowers. It is used in medicine, for walking sticks and light building, and in magic to crown a person to dominance.
summary.sw: *Chitadzi* ni mkitaji, kichaka cha maeneo makavu chenye majani kama manyoya na maua makubwa ya rangi ya zambarau hafifu yanayofanana na ya mbaazi. Hutumika katika dawa, kwa fimbo za kutembelea na ujenzi mwepesi, na kiuchawi kumvika mtu taji la kutawala wengine.
summary.dg: *Chitadzi* ni chitsaka cha tsi kavu chenye makodza dza nyoya na maruwa makulu ga zambarau dza ga kunde. Nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, kuhenda fwimbo za kunyendekera na kudzengera vitu vidide, na chiwanga kumvwika mutu chiremba cha utawala.

about.en: *Chitadzi* is a shrub with leaves made of many small, paired leaflets, giving it a fine, feathery look. Its flowers are large for the plant, mauve pea-flowers that stand out against the grey-green bush.
about.sw: *Chitadzi* ni kichaka chenye majani yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo vilivyopangwa kwa jozi, vinavyokipa sura laini kama ya manyoya. Maua yake ni makubwa ukilinganisha na ukubwa wa mmea, maua ya rangi ya zambarau hafifu yanayofanana na ya mbaazi, yanayojitokeza wazi dhidi ya kijani-kijivu cha vichaka.
about.dg: *Chitadzi* ni chitsaka chenye makodza ganayohendwa ni makodza madide manji ganayololana mairi-mairi, na ichi ndicho chinachochipha umbo ra nyoya. Maruwage ni makulu kpwa ukulu wa mmea, ga zambarau, dza maruwa ga kunde, na ganaonekana sana kahi ya weruni wa rangi ya chijani na ivu.

where.en: It grows in dry lowlands and coastal bushland.
where.sw: Huota katika nyanda za chini zilizo kavu na vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye tsi kavu ya photsi na weruni wa pwani.

uses.en: Roots, leaves and even the ash of the plant are used in traditional medicine. Its straight stems are used in light construction and made into walking sticks.
uses.sw: Mizizi, majani na hata jivu la mmea huu hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutumika katika ujenzi mwepesi na hutengenezwa fimbo za kutembelea.
uses.dg: Mizi, makodza na hata ivu ra mmea nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Makologe ganayogoloka nkuhumirwa kudzengera vitu vidide, na nkuhenderwa fwimbo za kunyendekera.

culture.en: Its name is explained as 'crown of honour'. It is used magically to crown someone to dominance: a charm for rank and respect.
culture.sw: Jina lake linaelezwa kuwa na maana ya 'taji la heshima'. Hutumika kiuchawi kumvika mtu taji la kutawala wengine: hirizi ya cheo na heshima.
culture.dg: Dzinare nkugombwa kukala rina mana ya 'chiremba cha hishima'. Nkuhumirwa chiwanga kumvwika mutu chiremba ili akale dzulu ya anzie: hirizi ya kuphaha cheo na hishima.

names.en: Pakia records *chitadzi*; ICRAF's handbook gives *mkitaji*, which is also the Swahili name. In Giriama it is *mkitaji* or *kitwadzi*. There is no common English name; botanists call it *Ormocarpum kirkii*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *chitadzi*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkitaji*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mkitaji* au *kitwadzi*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza; wataalamu wa mimea wanakiita *Ormocarpum kirkii*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chitadzi*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mkitaji*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mkitaji* au *kitwadzi*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinaromanyikana; asayansi anachiiha *Ormocarpum kirkii*.

reason.en: Another bush plant used as a social charm
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa vichakani unaotumika kama hirizi ya kijamii
reason.dg: *Chimwemwe*, mmea wanjina wa weruni unaohumirwa dza hirizi kahi ya atu

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa jamii ya kunde wa vichaka vikavu
reason.dg: *Chikwata kombe*, mmea wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa weruni mkavu

reason.en: Sicklebush, a legume of the same bushland
reason.sw: Mchinjiri (*sicklebush*), mmea wa jamii ya kunde wa vichaka hivyo hivyo
reason.dg: *Mchinjiri*, wa jamii ya kunde wa weruni uhu

reason.en: Winter cassia, a bush legume used in medicine
reason.sw: *Winter cassia*, mmea wa vichakani wa jamii ya kunde unaotumika katika dawa
reason.dg: *Muhumba*, wa jamii ya kunde wa weruni unaohumirwa kpwa dawa
